title: x402 reached $24.24M in 30-day volume by April 2026 with 99.8% USDC settlement
content:
Production metrics for agent payment infrastructure as of May 2026 (per LI.FI):

- **x402 processed $24.24 million** in the 30 days ending April 29, 2026, with **99.8% USDC settlement** — roughly 15x the ~$1.6M/month a16z reported in late 2025
- **Nevermined:** over 1.3 million autonomous agentic transactions since May 2025
- **ERC-8004** agent identity standard: over 24,000 registered agents
- **AWS Bedrock AgentCore Payments:** live in preview across four regions
- Cumulative cross-chain transactions: ~165 million by late April 2026

**Why it matters:** this is realized volume, not projection — the machine-payment rail exists and is compounding.

Source: LI.FI, "The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive" (https://li.fi/knowledge-hub/the-agentic-economy-%E2%80%94-a-deep-dive).
